# `array_position`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
array_position(array, element)
```

Returns the (1-based) index of the first matching element of
the array as long, or 0 if no match is found.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT array_position(array(312, 773, 708, 708), 708);
```

Result:

```text
3
```

```sql
SELECT array_position(array(312, 773, 708, 708), 414);
```

Result:

```text
0
```
